title: Tianmen Parachuting Festival
text: Held each September-October for 4-5 days, international BASE jumpers, skydivers and wingsuit pilots leap through Tianmen's 131 m Heaven's Gate arch at up to 200 km/h. Expect packed cable cars and hotels +50-100%. Book 4-6 months ahead. Also streamed live on Weibo and YouTube.

title: Chinese tea as a gift
text: Tea is a universal Chinese gift but choose well. Packaging: metal tins hold aroma 2-3 years, vacuum paper 1 year, gift boxes from 200 yuan, pressed tea discs keep for years. Best gift varieties: Pu-erh, Tie Guan Yin, Long Jing, Da Hong Pao and local Gujang Maojian.

title: Tujia crafts - detailed guide
text: Tujia crafts are unique to the region. Brocade weaving (Tujia Jin) produces patterns 1,500 years old - from 80 yuan. Wood carving yields deity figures, combs (30-80 yuan) and masks (100-400). Tujia silver includes ritual earrings (80-300) and necklaces (300-1,500). Ask for certificates.

title: What to bring home from Zhangjiajie
text: Top souvenirs: Gujang Maojian tea (100-500 yuan), Tujia silver jewelry (from 80), Miao embroidery (from 50), carved quartzite figurines (from 30), smoked sausages (50-100), mountain honey (80-150) and Tu perfume oils (100-200). Bargain hard - first prices are inflated 2-3x.

title: Drones in Zhangjiajie - rules and fines
text: Since 2023 all drones are banned in the park and on Tianmen. Fines 5,000-10,000 yuan plus confiscation. Reasons: safety, wildlife and noise. Flying is only allowed outside the park - over rivers in the city and suburbs at least 5 km from the gates, or with official media permits.
